pedal: Boss NS-2 Noise Suppressor (mono: Input -> Output; Send/Return empty)
comment: Locate today's near-threshold transition before selecting history-test levels. Threshold stays 3:00, Decay minimum, Mode Reduction. True bypass first: explicitly switch OFF. Each signal has a low reset, 2 dB rising staircase, a -12 dB open-path reference and a low closing step. Keep interface and input gain unchanged.

takes.name: bypass-locator-1000
takes.note: NS-2 OFF / BYPASSED, not engaged with its gate closed. Input -> Output; Send and Return empty. Set Mode Reduction, Threshold 3:00 and Decay fully counter-clockwise now. Input 2 physical gain stays fully counter-clockwise.

takes.name: threshold-0300-decay-0700-locator-1000
takes.note: Switch NS-2 ON. Threshold exactly 3:00; Decay fully counter-clockwise; Mode Reduction. Do not move Threshold or interface gain afterward; the next experiment will reuse this position.
